question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom. 

Spill the beans
solution:
The correct answer is option 3) **Give away a secret.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 
 
"Spill the beans" is a commonly used English idiom, which means** to reveal a secret or confidential information.**

 
 
• 
 
**Example:- **"He spilled the beans to his parents about his plans to move abroad after graduation."

 
 
• 
 
This implies divulging something that was meant to be kept hidden or private, often without the consent or knowledge of those who wanted the information kept secret.

 
 
• 
 
The phrase is often used in casual conversation, where the revealing of secrets or sensitive information may have significant implications. It can refer to personal secrets, business secrets, or any other kind of sensitive information.
